title: Zaldy Co's 3 co-accused declared fugitives; Ombudsman calls for action

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the Ombudsman on Thursday expressed hope that the Sandiganbayan Fifth Division’s declaration of former lawmaker Zaldy Co’s three co-accused as fugitives from justice, along with its order to cancel their passports, would prompt concerned government agencies to exhaust all available means to bring them before the courts. In a resolution promulgated on November 10, the court granted the prosecution’s motion to declare Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) materials engineer Timojen Sacar and Sunwest board members Anthony Ngo and Consuelo Aldon fugitives from justice.
